name: @w6w-apps/ninox
description: Read and write Ninox 4 records, inspect modules, tables, fields, views and reports, poll record changes, and run scripts in a Ninox workspace.

w6w.longDescription:
Ninox 4 is a low-code platform for building business apps: a workspace holds modules, each module holds tables, and each table holds fields and records. This app connects a workflow to one Ninox workspace through its public API.

It reads and writes records (list with filters, sorting and field selection; create, update, delete and upsert in batches of records), polls the change log of a table or of the workspace schema for incremental sync, and runs a Ninox script against a record. It also exposes the structure around the data: modules, tables, fields, views, reports and global function scripts, and renders a report to a PDF for a record.

A Ninox API key belongs to exactly one workspace, so a Connection is a workspace id plus its key. Creating or altering modules, tables and fields, file uploads and CSV import are not covered by this version.
